errors.evidence: The line starts at a training loss value just above 0.75, not 0.85. This is a significant overestimation.
The line ends at a training loss value close to 0.3 at the final training step (1400), not 0.35. The loss value is around 0.35 much earlier, between steps 200 and 600.
The description states the y-axis range is 0.3 to 0.7, but the data starts above 0.7 (around 0.76). This statement is also inconsistent with the description's own claim that the line starts at 0.85.
The description fails to mention the presence of a legend in the top right corner, which labels the line as 'Training Loss of Reward Model'.

errors.text_span: then fluctuates relatively steadily around 0.35 from around 600 to 1400 on the x-axis
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend in the latter half of the plot. The line does not fluctuate steadily around 0.35; it continues a gradual downward trend from approximately 0.35 toward 0.3 during this interval.
